remarks: Welcome to this newer luxury Townhouse available for rent starting April 2026. This beautiful condo is minutes away from downtown Stamford and close to all amenities and public transportation. Have access to all that Stamford has to offer. The Townhouse has 3 lovely bedrooms and 2.5bathrooms. Beautiful finishes and hardwood floor throughout. Walk up to a very private rooftop deck with beautiful views of the city of Stamford. Don't miss this one.
